{{Quote|You left us after the war. You deserted Clan Ordo to become a mercenary.''"<br />"''There was no Clan Ordo after the war. Tegris was dead. We had no leader. We were scattered.|[[Veela Ordo]] and [[Canderous Ordo]]|<ref name="Revan" />}}
'''Tegris Ordo''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]] who served as the [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] of [[Clan Ordo]] during the tumultuous period of [[Time/Legends|time]] known as the [[Mandalorian Wars]],<ref name="Revan" /> a [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] conflict between the Mandalorians and the dominant [[Politics/Legends|political]] body in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at the time, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> After the [[Battle of Malachor V|end]] of the wars and the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Tegris, Clan Ordo was left without a leader and subsequently became scattered.<ref name="Revan" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tegris Ordo was first mentioned in the [[2011]] novel, ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'' by [[Author/Legends|author]] [[Drew Karpyshyn]].
